summary.intent: Plan Phase 21 (BYO-IPFS Node Support) using the GSD workflow, then conduct a pre-implementation security review of the planning docs, and incorporate benchmarking and security hardening into the plans.
summary.outcome: Phase 21 planning completed with 7 plans across 4 waves (6 original + 1 benchmarking plan added). Security review identified 1 critical and 2 high-priority issues; all 3 were addressed by hardening Plans 01, 02, and 05. Plans committed to branch for PR #346.

repo: Phase 21 is BYO-IPFS Node Support — users can pin to their own Kubo node or PSA-compatible provider instead of CipherBox's infrastructure.
Current staging instance handles ~200 concurrent users; IPFS pinning (~3 Kubo calls per upload, ~1.37s each) accounts for ~95% of upload endpoint time.
The staging VPS plateaus at ~23-28 ops/s throughput and starts erroring at 200 concurrent clients.
BYO+Kubo external-only mode reduces per-upload API time from ~4.2s to ~105ms — a ~40x reduction — shifting the bottleneck from Kubo pin throughput to PostgreSQL write throughput.
BYO+PSA mode still uses CipherBox as a transient relay (upload → PSA pinByCid → wait → unpin), so it has a nearly identical load profile to the current CipherBox-only path.
TEE worker uses Uint8Array.fill(0) for IPNS key zeroing in republish.ts — migration worker must follow the same pattern; JS strings are immutable and cannot be zeroed.
Load test harness lives in tests/load/src/ with scenarios in scenarios/ and client pool in harness/client-pool.ts.
Existing baselines captured in .planning/baselines/ — most recent is 19.2-post-optimization-baselines.md.
Planning docs commit hook runs markdownlint — bold emphasis used as headings (e.g. **Assessment: ...**) triggers lint failures.

code.finding: Migration worker's fetchFromProvider/pinToProvider accept arbitrary URLs from decrypted user configs with no SSRF protection — must add HTTPS-only enforcement, private IP blocking (including 169.254.169.254), and DNS rebinding protection before implementation.

POST /ipfs/register-cid endpoint had no CID format validation, no size cap, no BYO-user authorization gate, and no rate limit — any authenticated user could abuse it to bypass quota enforcement or inject arbitrary size values.
KuboProvider CID parameters in URL construction needed encodeURIComponent — raw CIDs passed into URL strings without encoding.
Correct pattern for credential zeroing in TEE: uses Uint8Array.fill(0) for IPNS keys — this is the reference implementation the migration worker should replicate.
Existing load test scenario structure to follow when adding BYO benchmarking scenarios — stepped client pool expansion, per-operation metric recording.

workflow: GSD plan-phase revision loop (max 3 iterations) caught 5 blockers on first checker pass; all resolved in 1 revision cycle before final verification pass.

Running security:review against planning docs (before implementation) rather than code is an effective pre-implementation gate — findings can be addressed cheaply as plan edits rather than code changes.
Background agents (security review) can run in parallel while discussing unrelated topics (benchmarking strategy), efficiently using wait time.
Plan file markdownlint errors block commits — bold-as-heading pattern (**Text:**) needs to be converted to plain text or proper heading syntax.

friction: Markdownlint rejected the security review report due to **Assessment: ...** bold-emphasis-as-heading pattern, requiring multiple edit passes to fix before commit could proceed.
Plan frontmatter requirements field uses indented list format (  - BYO-06) that caused a grep to miss BYO-06 coverage initially, requiring a secondary verification pass.
open_items: External IPFS provider selection for benchmarking left open — need to decide between Pinata, Filebase, or another provider with sufficient rate limits for load testing.
Need to determine whether to use a separate Pinata test account or the existing CipherBox account for load test runs.
Medium-priority security findings from REVIEW-2026-03-24-phase21-pre-impl.md not yet addressed in plans (4 medium + 5 low issues remain).
VALIDATION.md plan mapping errors flagged by the checker were noted as warnings but not explicitly resolved — worth verifying Plan 05/06 coverage in VALIDATION.md.
Benchmarking plan (21-07) requires a real external IPFS provider to be configured via env vars before Task 4 (run benchmarks + capture baselines) can execute — this is a checkpoint task.
CI strategy for BYO scenarios unclear — scenarios skip gracefully without env vars but the external-provider integration path won't be validated in automated CI without provider credentials.
